episodes.title: My Love Life Started the Day It Ended
episodes.summary: At the start of her sophomore year, Ichica's elite girls' school merges with a boys' school. Principal Ikushima announces a strict "No Romance" rule.

episodes.title: Rabbit Hunting
episodes.summary: While Ichica struggles to make ends meet, an anonymous tip leads to a cruel expulsion. The school intensifies its surveillance with "Rabbit Hunters."

episodes.title: School Choir Crush
episodes.summary: When a compromising photo of two choir students is leaked on the school app, Ichica receives a cry for help. Ms. Shinoda is visited by a guilty student.

episodes.title: Three Reasons Not to Fall in Love
episodes.summary: Maki grows closer to Ichica and opens up. Under Principal Ikushima's directive, the Rabbit Hunters intensify their crusade during the school trip.

episodes.title: Why Doesn’t Gay Romance Count?
episodes.summary: Kanda intervenes to save Ichica from a suspicious Sawa. Ichica discovers a photo of a gay couple. Maki's interactions with Ayami cause a misunderstanding.

episodes.title: Romance at the School Festival
episodes.summary: At the school festival, the Love Keepers try to hide Koharu's relationship from the Rabbit Hunters. Maki and Ichica sort out their complicated feelings.

episodes.title: Is It a Crime to Fall in Love?
episodes.summary: After a photo of her secret makeout session with Maki is leaked online, Ichica undergoes a harsh interrogation. Later, she makes a bold declaration.

episodes.title: My Life, My Rules.
episodes.summary: The trial between Ichica and Asuran Academy begins, and her friends rally around her. Will Ichica be able to find justice for herself and her schoolmates?
